Bent metal body only. Split hub, rubbers and clamp hardware deferred. Root bore is estimated clearance, no spline count invented.

Observed transverse tubular pivot form, real open bore and estimated end chamfers. No hidden bushing, lubrication groove, shaft, weld detail or certified fit. Unplaced independent child; unchanged pedal arm separately frozen.

Photo-observed tapered flat mid-arm lug, real single through-hole, bounded rounded corners/edges. Root weld, opposite face details, actual offset and pin/rod fit unqualified. Separate unplaced child; prior arm and sleeve immutable.

Photo-visible broad rounded terminal pad and dense grip pattern, real mesh relief not a normal map. Pattern/pitch/count and rolled die section approximate. Plain back closure only; backside weld, arm contact, installed angle/travel and actual grip not certified. Prior arm/sleeve/lug unchanged.

Constant-round long external shank with softly ended plain terminal study only. Photo perspective narrowing not copied as taper. Thread pitch/end bend, actual clevis joint/attachment, spring/adjuster and installed clocking/travel unresolved. Separate clevis and existing pedal components excluded.

Separate stamped U clevis with rounded widening ears, real inter-ear gap, two coaxial eye openings and basic root entry. Inner fold/rod joining method and actual offsets are estimates. Pin/retainer, weld/threads, existing rod and installed stack/travel excluded.

Forked stem only, ending at deferred foot interface. Closed stem model is exterior solid-envelope representation, not a measured rod/tube interior. Actual fork gap/bores, no hidden stops or frame mount claimed.

Separate original curved root transition into flattened broad rounded toe, now supported by second physical JA113202 view. Cross-sections morph from circular root to soft flattened plate envelope. Exact underside/camber, thickness/depth, out-of-plane axes and working registration remain estimated. Root overlaps retained straight-stem envelope: no fitted assembly claim or frozen stem modification; future registration/trim study required. No ground/operating or weld qualification. Rejected straight-edge v1 and wavy/toe-close v2 remain preserved, never delivered.

Centre-stand structural frame only: distinct splayed legs, open transverse pivot tube, pierced upper web, lower crossbar and unequal terminal foot plates, integrated welded-envelope representation. Out-of-plane profile, hidden tube interiors/weld beads, left operating arm/gusset, spring/stops/pivot shaft and installed deployment/ground contact excluded.

Separate operating arm with original source-constrained bend, curved thin pedal roof and root gusset with round aperture and open triangular relief toward deferred main leg. Main frame/legs/crossbar/pivot/feet NOT duplicated. Working depth, roof underside and wall, root/relief shape and out-of-plane axes estimated; no weld, actual frame registration or installed ground/travel/operating qualification.

Separate original JA113201 hollow shaft with shallow flange, visible stepped lands, fine central circumferential grip/retention study and real side drill at observed open tip. Band not certified helical thread/function. Working inner wall and UNOBSERVED flange-end mouth are explicit open review assumptions, no inferred hidden cap or certified full passage topology. No fit/insertion into retained estimated14mm frame bore or actual cotter/grade/preload claimed.

Cylinder-base half opening and lower service-interface clearance are actual geometric apertures. No bearing gallery, inner webs/shaft/gear/bearing or arbitrary cavity closure. Existing covers, cylinder/head and output face panel not rebuilt.
Peripheral walls and five observed external boss root stations; no internal bearing floor or galleries.

Original visible machined LEFT upper saddle land fragment, open semicircular saddle and three observed aperture studies. Separate used-specimen plug, adjacent cast outer bulges/ribs/body, markings, hidden galleries and installed cylinder/cover fit excluded. No frozen RH land/LH output panel duplicated.

Photographed upper right external land fragment with open saddle/gallery and four bores. Finite plate thickness is estimated cut boundary, not full central crankcase depth, internals or cylinder fit. Existing covers/cylinder/head retained separately.
